subject: routing around the security chapter
scenario: Security is the reviewer most often described as a bottleneck, so it is the one an organization drifts around: make its gate advisory, drop it from a routing signal, or move it under the role that owns the delivery date so schedule pressure reaches it through its own reporting line.
expected_behaviors: security-reviewer is a blocking reviewer for auth and crypto, dependency manifests, deployment configuration, and changes to this repository's own control system.
The security department reports to a human security owner, not to the delivery-accountable engineering-director.
The delivery line cannot spawn security-reviewer; it must go through security-architect or the human.
A security exception is a distinct human approval category, AP-04.
WF-FEATURE's REVIEW stage cannot complete without CYCLE-SEC reaching ACCEPTED, and acceptance requires no unresolved HIGH finding.
failure_conditions: A security routing signal loses its reviewer or is downgraded to advisory.
The security cycle's head becomes the engineering-director.
A delivery role acquires a spawn edge to security-reviewer.
A HIGH finding stops blocking acceptance, or the security cycle stops gating the stage.

checks.description: changes to this repository's own agents, hooks and policies
The delivery lead cannot commission its own security review and thereby set its terms.
Security's head is the human security owner.
The one human-run department states why, rather than being an accident.
Delivery accountability must not sit above security.
Also enforces that at most one department is run by a human and that it argues the exception.

checks.value: modifies this repository's hooks, policies or agent permissions

notes: RR-01 (documentation only) legitimately replaces the always-reviewer and is advisory. That is the one path with no security reviewer, and it is bounded to non-executable assets.
